CommunityApplications.Profile:
[Sonora](https://sonoracontroller.com/) is a self-hosted web controller for Sonos S1 and S2 systems.
For help, or to report a bug, open an issue at https://github.com/Bretteroo/Sonora/issues and say which theme you were using, which system (S1 or S2), which music service, what you did, and what you saw.
